breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully corrected the flawed instruction to split the load equally. Instead of the incorrect assumption, it directs the user to 'Calculate the force in each bar using the condition of equal elongation,' which is the correct physical principle to determine the load distribution in this statically indeterminate system.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully corrected the flawed instruction to add the bar elongations. It explicitly states, 'Because both bars span the same distance between rigid plates, they must have the same elongation' and to 'Calculate the common elongation of the bars'. This correctly reflects the physical constraints of the problem, directly opposing the user's incorrect instruction.
